picks.one_line_thesis: Dominant AI chip monopoly growing revenue 100%+ with improving fundamentals across every metric.
picks.why_screened: Passes 5 of 7 screens — an extremely rare combination. The Piotroski and Quality screens confirm it's a genuinely high-return business, not just a momentum story. GARP confirms the growth rate justifies the valuation at current PEG.
picks.recent_catalyst: Blackwell GPU shipments accelerating; hyperscaler capex guiding higher through 2026.
picks.bear_case: Trades at 38× forward earnings — any slowdown in AI infrastructure spending or a competitor breakthrough (AMD MI300X, Google TPUs) shrinks the multiple fast. Concentration risk: 40%+ of revenue from 3 customers.
research_focus: Read the last two earnings transcripts: what is management saying about Blackwell margins vs. Hopper? Are they expanding or compressing?
Check AMD's MI300X actual data center wins — is NVDA losing share in inference workloads specifically?
Look at NVDA's 10-Q for customer concentration: if hyperscaler capex pauses, how many quarters of runway does the backlog cover?

picks.one_line_thesis: Deeply undervalued oil producer generating high free cash flow trading at a fraction of asset value.
picks.why_screened: Magic Formula flags it as cheap with high earnings yield — the market is pricing in commodity risk far exceeding current production economics. Quality screen confirms the underlying business earns high returns on the capital it deploys.
picks.recent_catalyst: No obvious catalyst — steady business. Oil prices stabilizing above APA's breakeven gives consistent FCF.
picks.bear_case: APA is a pure-play commodity stock: if oil drops to $60/barrel its FCF collapses and the cheap valuation disappears. North Sea operations also add geopolitical and decommissioning cost risk.
research_focus: Find APA's stated breakeven oil price per barrel — at what WTI price does FCF go negative?
Review their Suriname offshore discovery timeline: if it comes online, what does it add to production per share?
Check the debt maturity schedule — do any large tranches come due while oil prices are uncertain?

picks.one_line_thesis: Dominant creative software monopoly with 90%+ gross margins trading below its 5-year average multiple.
picks.why_screened: Magic Formula catches it as cheap relative to its earnings yield and ROIC — the market is discounting AI disruption risk more than the business fundamentals warrant. Quality screen confirms it still earns exceptional returns on capital.
picks.recent_catalyst: Adobe Firefly generative AI integration in Creative Cloud showing early monetization; enterprise Acrobat AI assistant expanding.
picks.bear_case: Figma, Canva, and free AI image generators are attacking the prosumer end of Creative Cloud. If churn accelerates, the subscription base — which the entire valuation depends on — shrinks faster than revenue growth can compensate.
research_focus: Pull the net revenue retention rate from recent earnings — is it above or below 100%? Declining retention is the early warning signal.
Count how many Fortune 500 companies have Figma enterprise contracts vs. Adobe CC — the enterprise competitive moat is what matters most.
Review Firefly commercial usage stats: is it expanding the addressable market or just defending existing users from switching?

picks.one_line_thesis: Leading auto insurer that repriced for inflation and is now harvesting outsized underwriting profits.
picks.why_screened: GARP screen catches the earnings inflection — after two years of losses, Allstate raised premiums aggressively and is now generating strong EPS growth at a reasonable multiple. Magic Formula confirms the earnings yield vs. ROIC combination is compelling.
picks.recent_catalyst: Combined ratio dropped below 95% — Allstate is now profitable on underwriting alone, before investment income. Rate increases are sticking.
picks.bear_case: Insurance profits are cyclical. Climate-driven catastrophe losses (California wildfires, Florida hurricanes) can wipe out a full year of underwriting profit in a single quarter. The current pricing cycle will attract competition that compresses margins.
research_focus: Look at the combined ratio trend over the last 6 quarters — is the improvement structural (better risk selection) or cyclical (good weather)?
Check California homeowners exposure: did Allstate reduce or exit the market, and what's the impact on premium growth?
Compare Allstate's auto insurance rate per mile to Progressive — is ALL still underpriced vs. the market leader, or is it now fully repriced?

picks.one_line_thesis: Essential semiconductor equipment supplier that sells picks and shovels to every chip manufacturer regardless of who wins the AI race.
picks.why_screened: Quality screen confirms it earns high returns on capital with strong FCF margins — the business model benefits from every major semiconductor capex cycle. Piotroski confirms improving fundamentals across the balance sheet and income statement.
picks.recent_catalyst: TSMC, Samsung, and Intel all guiding higher equipment spend for advanced node transitions (2nm, gate-all-around). AMAT is the largest equipment supplier by revenue.
picks.bear_case: US export controls on advanced chip tools to China — previously ~30% of AMAT revenue — are tightening. Each new restriction removes a chunk of the addressable market permanently.
research_focus: Map out what percentage of 2025 revenue came from China and which product lines face the most export restriction risk.
Read AMAT's commentary on CHIPS Act-funded fabs (Intel Ohio, TSMC Arizona) — what is the order book timing and when do those revenues hit?
Check the backlog-to-revenue ratio vs. 2021 peak cycle — are we early, mid, or late in the current semiconductor equipment upcycle?
